intro: This investigation unearths a forgotten chapter in the dark tale of Stalvan Mistmantle. A dusty, unsent letter pulled from a neglected footlocker in Moonbrook provides tangible proof of where he stayed before his vanished trail turned cold, leading back to Darkshire's records.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You find a Dusty Unsent Letter in the old footlocker.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, I remember you. You're the one who was asking about that Stalvan fellow. Did you ever find what you were looking for?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Interesting. So the chap did spend some time in Moonbrook after all. It is rather odd the letter never got delivered. Nonetheless, I shall update the registry.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
